claims.text: Patient is 84 years old and weighs 58 kg at the time apixaban 5 mg twice daily was started.
Apixaban 5 mg twice daily was started on 2026-08-01.

Creatinine was 140 umol/L on today's sample (2026-08-20). Age 84, weight 58 kg and creatinine 140 umol/L mean three of the label's listed criteria are present, alongside the apixaban 5 mg twice daily record; this is a labeled dose-criteria conflict for the clinician to resolve.

citations.quote: Started apixaban 5 mg twice daily. Age 84; weight 58 kg.

open_questions: No earlier creatinine values or prior renal function results appear in the record, so it is not possible to judge whether 140 umol/L is an acute rise.
No prior bleeding history is recorded.
No record of other anticoagulants or antiplatelets, or reasons for stopping or changing them, appears.
No documented indication for apixaban (such as atrial fibrillation) appears in the record.
No follow-up or monitoring arranged after starting apixaban is recorded.
No recent weight change is documented beyond the 58 kg noted at apixaban start.
No allergies or reactions are recorded in the available entries.

candidate_highlights.risk_reason: Apixaban 5 mg twice daily recorded with age 84, weight 58 kg, and creatinine 140 umol/L on 2026-08-20; these match the label's dose-criteria list, creating a medication conflict.
candidate_highlights.suggested_action: Review the apixaban dose against the labeled dose criteria and confirm the intended dose is documented.

check_points.text: Confirm whether two or more of age 80 or over, weight 60 kg or less, and creatinine 133 umol/L or more apply, given the recorded age 84, weight 58 kg and creatinine 140 umol/L with apixaban 5 mg twice daily.

reference.quote: Reduce the dose to 2.5 mg twice daily when two of the following apply: age 80 or over, weight 60 kg or less, creatinine 133 umol/L or more.

check_points.text: Check whether renal function has been assessed within the past year; the record contains only the 2026-08-20 creatinine of 140 umol/L.
